children: The new facility expands Thyrocare’s diagnostic network in Jharkhand, offering routine and specialised testing to patients and healthcare partners

Thyrocare Technologies has expanded its diagnostic network in eastern India with the launch of a new laboratory in Jamshedpur, Jharkhand, in collaboration with SecondMedic. Inaugurated by Piyush Singh, Vice President, Thyrocare Technologies, the facility is aimed at improving access to diagnostic testing across Jamshedpur and surrounding regions.

The laboratory will cater to both routine and specialised diagnostic requirements and is supported by trained professionals and Thyrocare’s diagnostic infrastructure. The company said the facility will enable timely sample processing and report delivery while extending access to its diagnostic services beyond major metropolitan markets.

The expansion comes as diagnostic providers increasingly seek to strengthen their presence in emerging regional markets. Through its partnership with SecondMedic, Thyrocare aims to build a stronger local network while providing healthcare partners and patients in Jharkhand with access to its testing capabilities.

Rahul Guha, MD and CEO, Thyrocare, said, “At Thyrocare, our focus has always been on making quality and trustworthy diagnostic services more accessible to people across India. The launch of our laboratory in Jamshedpur, in partnership with SecondMedic, is another step towards making our presence strong in the emerging markets and bringing our technology-led diagnostic capabilities closer to patients.” He added that the company remained focused on building a network combining affordability, quality and accessibility for both ongoing and preventive healthcare requirements.

Rajdeep Panwar, Chief Commercial Officer, Thyrocare, said Jamshedpur was an important market as the company expands its presence across eastern India. “The introduction of our new laboratory, in collaboration with SecondMedic in Jamshedpur, will help us in strengthening our local diagnostic capabilities while maintaining the turnaround and quality standards associated with Thyrocare,” Panwar said.

The company said the facility will help increase access to diagnostic services for patients and healthcare partners across Jamshedpur and neighbouring areas. Thyrocare said the expansion is aligned with its broader strategy of extending its diagnostic footprint beyond metropolitan centres. The launch also adds to the company’s efforts to build a wider diagnostic network that combines standardised testing, affordability and accessibility across different regional markets.
